scenario_notes.outage: Assumed application disconnection, not historical exchange evidence. Offline interval [08:55,09:15) Beijing. Funding accrues at exchange; no new decisions or fills during blackout. Discard pending entry on disconnect; reconnect uses a fresh signal.
scenario_notes.cost2: Both spot/swap fee rates and adverse execution slippage doubled; threshold costs also doubled.

execution: Causal minute model using completed minute for evaluation; entry due +1 minute and fresh funding/cost/sizing recheck; exit due +1 minute as common historical broker approximation. Two-leg same-minute fills assumed. Historical bid/ask absent; trade prices plus adverse slippage and tick rounding proxy. No private API or live orders.
rules: Use unchanged production F3 strategy economic pure functions; scheduling is the only F3/G3 difference. Retain daily 09:00 exit review, 168h minimum hold, 24h cooldown, 3 bad days, loss/drawdown/margin/residual limits, neutral treasury. Budget remains capped at min(25, equity).
funding: Settled BTC-USD-SWAP rates only, available +1 minute, preceding settlement anchors full 14-day history; no USDT swap funding substitution. Positive funding at exact entry/exit boundary conservatively not credited; negative exit boundary funding charged.
mark: Only hourly mark OHLC available. Hour opens are used at exact hour/settlement aliases; intervening completed swap close is a causal proxy. No intra-hour future high/low/close used.
limitations: Public historical price model, not real fills or profitability proof.
Previously researched history, not independent holdout.
No historical order book, partial fills, market impact, minute marks, funding bill timestamps, actual outages or liquidations.
Model risk actions delayed one minute; real executor uses polling and actual exchange state.
Mark limitation prevents minute-accurate liquidation reconstruction.
model_max_loss_note: Original user total-loss limit of 10 USDT retained in both versions. Independent 3% per-group loss and 5% peak drawdown guards remain.
